text:
Nora: tiny idea  holiday mug swap + 10-minute meme gauntlet at lunch next Wed? bring a mug (or a note if you want to swap via delivery) and one silly meme to share. winner gets a mystery snack box. low pressure. :coffee::package:

Jamal: love this. are mugs allowed to be 'sentimental but slightly questionable'? asking for a friend. :eyes:

Priya: yes to sentimental questionable mugs. also can we do a 'best mug caption' quick vote?

Leo: happy to host the meme gauntlet. format proposal: 1) quick 1min show-and-tell for mugs 2) 10 memes posted in thread 3) react voting for top 3. sound good?

Hana: i volunteer to curate a 'no-nuts' snack option for the mystery box. also PSA: label food pls.

Nora: signup format (copy/paste):
```
Name  Mug swap (in-person/dropoff OR ship)  meme topic (optional)
```

MxBot: Calendar event created: "Mug Swap + Meme Gauntlet" Wed 12:15 PT. Reply 'join' to RSVP via bot.

Jamal: Jamal  dropoff  "awkward family holiday photo" meme

Priya: Priya  ship  "cozy cat chaos" meme

Leo: Leo  dropoff  "holiday snack engineering" meme

Hana: Hana  dropoff  "tiny tree renovations" meme

Nora: tiny extra rule  if your mug breaks in transit, you owe the winner a pun. fair? :grin:

Jamal: fair. pun marketplace open.

Priya: quick poll: do we want a sticker station to decorate swapped mugs? react :sparkles: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no.

Jamal: :sparkles:

Leo: :sparkles:

Hana: :sparkles:

Nora: stickers engaged. i will bring a sheet of holiday and 'brand-safe' stickers.

MxBot: Reminder: event in 3 days. Add to calendar? Reply 'yes'.

Leo: logistics note: anyone shipping, DM me for the office mailing address and mark "mug swap" on package. i'll stash labeled boxes at reception.

Priya: remote option? my friend is remote and wants to join meme drop. can we allow screenshots/zoom cameo for mug show?

Nora: yes — remote cameo welcome. we'll allocate 2 quick spots for camera show-and-tell.

Hana: trading policy: if you swap and then regret it, you have a 24h 'mug regret' window to swap back. :laughing:

Jamal: who is bringing tape/paper for shipping last-minute swaps? i can bring tape.

Nora: thanks jamal. i will bring packing paper and a tiny repair kit (super glue + band-aids).

Leo: meme rules (copy/paste):
- keep workplace-safe
- one meme per person
- post in thread as image or paste link
- top 3 by reactions get snack prizes

Priya: also: tiny raffle for everyone who participates  1 ticket per activity (mug swap, meme, sticker). raffle drawn at end.

Nora: perfect. last ask: if you're bringing food/snacks, write allergens next to your signup line.

Jamal: jamal  dropoff  "awkward family holiday photo"  cookies (contains nuts)

Hana: hana  dropoff  "tiny tree renovations"  nut-free granola bars

Priya: priya  ship  "cozy cat chaos"  biscotti (contains almonds)

Nora: thanks folks  posting a tiny banner in #announcements now. see you for mugs, memes, and questionable puns. :mug::laughing:
